content: We need to propose a retrosynthesis route up to 5 steps, leaves must be commercially available, total price <= $9999. Need to construct route using templates. We have one template (38653) that matches our target: it is a cyclization forming a tetrahydropyran? The retro template: product -> precursors: [C:1]/[CH]=[CH]/[C:4] >> [C:1]-[C@@H]1-O-[C@H]-1-[C:4]. So it breaks a dihydropyran ring to give an allylic chain with a double bond and a carbonyl? Actually product is our target (a cyclic acetal?). The retro step would open the cyclic ether to give a linear precursor: an allylic alcohol? Let's apply template to get precursors.
